reviewer_statement: Human-reviewed against the pinned Embodied-Navigator README: selected the controlled Memory block, Full AT-Mem as candidate, Full history as baseline, and SR as the higher-is-better metric on both reported benchmarks. No automatic system is authorized to change this selection.
required_source_phrases: All variants below use the same Qwen2.5-VL-7B policy, sensing inputs, validation-unseen splits, fixed non-learned SLAM controller, and evaluation protocol. Each block changes only its named component.
credit_target: Anchor-Trajectory Memory contribution within the authors' controlled Memory ablation block
claim_if_advance: on the pinned reported matched-policy validation-unseen ablation, Full Anchor-Trajectory Memory retains provisional conditional credit over full-history memory, with positive SR deltas on both R2R-CE and RxR-CE; this does not establish general memory superiority or independent replication
claim_if_not_advance: the human-approved pinned controlled comparison does not establish conditional credit for Full Anchor-Trajectory Memory
